$comment: ZTAX-PRIV-001's closed privacy vocabularies, as data. The contract lint (tools/lint.mjs, rule privacy-classified-fields) and the Go domain (backend/internal/domain/privacy, whose test reads this file) both take their vocabulary from here, so the two cannot drift. Adding a value is a reviewed privacy change: PRIV-001 §6 forbids reusing a purpose to legitimise different processing.
source: ZTAX-PRIV-001 v1.0 §3 (processing roles), §4 (classes), §5 (ProcessingActivity: DPIA status, collection source), §6 (purposes), §11 (legal basis), §14 (retention), §16 (transfer mechanism), §24 (field metadata)

purposes.PURP-TAX-CALC: Calculate/classify tax, fees and telecom fiscal treatment
purposes.PURP-OBL: Determine registrations, reporting and regulatory obligations
purposes.PURP-FILE: Prepare/submit returns, registrations, e-invoices or authority reports
purposes.PURP-RECON: Reconcile calculated, invoiced, collected, reported and remitted positions
purposes.PURP-EVID: Maintain legally required evidence, replay and dispute support
purposes.PURP-SEC: Security, authentication, fraud/abuse prevention and incident response
purposes.PURP-SUPPORT: Resolve customer support cases under scoped access
purposes.PURP-SVCOPS: Operate, monitor and improve reliability using minimized telemetry
purposes.PURP-LEGAL: Legal claims, regulator response, legal hold and legal obligations

retention.RET-TRANSIENT: Seconds/minutes/hours; raw evidence where derivation is sufficient
retention.RET-FISCAL: Tax/regulatory record period determined by pack/legal profile
retention.RET-CUSTOM: Customer-specific lawful/contractual configuration within legal bounds

redaction.NONE: May appear in logs and telemetry as-is
redaction.REDACT: Appears in logs and telemetry only in redacted form
redaction.NO_LOG: Never appears in logs, telemetry or error messages, redacted or not

evidencePolicy.RAW_REQUIRED: The raw value is retained as evidence
evidencePolicy.DERIVED_ONLY: Only the derived fact is retained; the raw value is discarded
evidencePolicy.SOURCE_HELD: The customer or source holds the raw value; ZoikoTax holds a reference

aiAllowed.DERIVED_ONLY: Only derived, non-identifying facts may reach a model
aiAllowed.APPROVED_MODEL_GATEWAY: May reach an approved use case through the Governed Model Gateway

processingRole.PROCESSOR: Zoiko processes customer personal data solely on documented customer instructions
processingRole.CONTROLLER: Zoiko determines purposes and means for its own workforce, security, telemetry, administration or legally required processing
processingRole.INDEPENDENT_CONTROLLER: Zoiko and customer/partner each independently determine purposes; expressly identified, never assumed
processingRole.JOINT_CONTROLLER: Joint determination established by legal analysis, with an allocation arrangement
processingRole.SUBPROCESSOR: A third party processing personal data on Zoiko's behalf under contractual and technical controls
processingRole.RECIPIENT_AUTHORITY: A tax, telecom, payment, court or other authority receiving data under filing or legal process

legalBasis.CONTRACT: Necessary for the contracted service, where applicable law supports it
legalBasis.LEGAL_OBLIGATION: A jurisdiction-specific legal obligation, never generalised globally
legalBasis.LEGITIMATE_INTERESTS: Documented necessity and balancing where applicable
legalBasis.CONSENT: Specific, informed, revocable and granular where legally required
legalBasis.PUBLIC_TASK: Public task or authority mandate, only where the role and law support it
legalBasis.CUSTOMER_INSTRUCTION: A documented customer instruction, Zoiko acting as processor
legalBasis.LOCAL_STATUTORY: Another local statutory basis, represented in the jurisdiction PrivacyProfile

dpiaStatus.NOT_REQUIRED: Screening concluded no assessment is required
dpiaStatus.SCREEN_REQUIRED: Screening has not yet been completed
dpiaStatus.REQUIRED: An assessment is required and not yet approved
dpiaStatus.REVIEW_DUE: The approved assessment is due for reassessment

collectionSource.NETWORK: Observed from network or service signalling

transferMechanism.NOT_RESTRICTED: Movement the applicable legal profile does not treat as a restricted transfer; still recorded
transferMechanism.ADEQUACY: An adequacy decision or equivalent recognised by the exporting jurisdiction
transferMechanism.CONTRACTUAL_SAFEGUARDS: Approved contractual clauses or equivalent appropriate safeguards
transferMechanism.DEROGATION: A specific derogation or exception permitted by the exporting jurisdiction
transferMechanism.LOCAL_STATUTORY: Another mechanism defined by the exporting jurisdiction's PrivacyProfile

rules.$comment: Enforced by the lint and by privacy.Metadata.Validate.
